scope: New Hunyuan GLB rebuild only; old rejected geometry and realistic skin maps were not used.
findings: Original material omits metallicFactor; glTF default is 1. Rebuilt skin/cloth/hair should explicitly be non-metallic.
Original atlas contains usable garment details but also hair/skin boundary contamination and a false back button placket.
199 original triangles have nearly zero UV area; new baking alone does not fix them.
Approximate head/neck UV share is 11.245 percent and hands 2.873 percent; dedicated new face and hand UVs are appropriate.

interfaces.create_palette: Returns skin/skin_back/sclera/iris/mouth/lash/brow plus hair/cloth material keys. sRGB palette is converted to linear shader values explicitly.
interfaces.bake_iris_image: Serial Blender bake of a newly authored UV iris shader to 1024 PNG: grey-brown iris, dark pupil/rim, small highlight; no old atlas resize.
interfaces.bake_face_skin_image: Serial Blender bake to new 2048 front skin image using actual face_spec.front_uv and eye positions, subtle cheek warmth only, no hair/eyes/mouth projected onto skin.
interfaces.bake_repaired_body_atlas: Serial Blender EMIT bake of copied retained mesh using explicit world-space, face-normal and optional luminance masks; preserves original UV and unaffected atlas colour. Returns exportable direct-image PBR material.
interfaces.material_export_audit: Reports material/image linkage, packed state, dimensions, metallic values and image colour spaces.

limitations: Plain atlas repair colour is a conservative local replacement; inspect any loss of seam/crease detail.
Front collar masks must follow actual separated hair/cloth geometry, not global dark-pixel replacement.
No normal map is fabricated from the colour image.
No original GLB, atlas, main Blender source or public state was modified by this task.
